RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Neither is choosing someone with fewer years in news: digital expertise, leadership, and interview performance may legitimately outweigh tenure.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and any available review procedure. Check applicable complaint deadlines rather than waiting indefinitely.

Raise potential sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks, inconsistent criteria, or different treatment of comparable candidates—not simply because the panel members were women. A numerical likelihood here would imply knowledge we don’t have.
